title: M5 Task 9 gate-2 induced-failure drill suite
notes: No provider process is spawned by any drill (native runtimes are never enabled).

The gate-2 failure behaviors are proven by adversarial induced-failure tests that were written RED-first across the M5 slices. This manifest is the authoritative gate-2 -> test map; run-gate2-drills.sh executes the whole corpus green at <=2 workers and stages the JSON/text evidence next to this file.

packages/engine/test/provider-index/gate2-drills.test.ts is a NEW dependency-light drill file added by this task that reproduces the cross-cutting properties (v13 migration recovery, flag-rollback no-down-migration, DB-busy fail-closed, invalid/unknown-fingerprint locator, cursor scope abuse, path-free fingerprint) directly against the real engine APIs so the gate-2 intent is asserted in one legible place.
